verdict.rationale: OCI documents that its CLI provides the same core functionality as the Console plus additional commands, and that this sits on typical REST APIs with SDKs and a Terraform provider, so the core of API/UI parity is a first-party claim. The docs only say "core" functionality, and account upgrade is described only through the Console, so parity for every UI action is not evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that every Console action (including account and billing operations like upgrading) is exposed via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
